sections.text: Millionaire for Life™ is a multi-state daily draw game. Play for your chance to win $1,000,000 a year for LIFE!

Millionaire for Life costs $5 per play and has the HIGHEST daily jackpot in lottery history. Choose 5 out of 58 numbers for the white balls, then pick your Millionaire Ball™ number from 1 to 5. You can choose your own numbers or ask for an Easy Pick to have the lottery terminal or self-service kiosk to select the numbers on your ticket. Check the multi-draw box to buy tickets for up to 10 consecutive drawings at a time. Millionaire for Life drawings are held daily at approximately 10:15 p.m. Here in Iowa, tickets may be purchased until 8:59 p.m. each day.

The set prize amounts for the top prize and tier 2 prize published here are based on the expected number of winners sharing in the prize pool. In some cases, these prizes may be paid on a pari-mutuel basis and will be lower than these prize levels.
There are nine prize levels in the game. Millionaire for Life prizes won in Iowa must be claimed within 180 days of the drawing in which they were won.
Millionaire for Life Top and Tier 2 Prize Options

Millionaire for Life’s top two prize levels are described as “lasting as long as you do,” meaning that they are truly for life. The minimum guaranteed payout for those two prize levels is 20 years, and there is a lump-sum option for players who prefer that rather than lifetime annuity payments

rows: $1 Million a year for life divided*

sections.text: *A minimum annuitized prize value is $50,000 per year for life. **See game rules Section 6.C. Prize Liability Limitation.

Players have 60 days from the date they claim their prize to choose the cash or annuity payment option. Prizes that are governed by "split-prize" liability are divided equally among the winning tickets and may be less than shown.
For further details, see the official Game Rules .

Millionaire for Life launched Feb. 22, 2026, in Iowa and 30 other jurisdictions. The game joined the Multi-State Lottery Association (MUSL) lineup, which also includes Powerball and Lotto America in Iowa.

rows: Select three numbers (unique or not) to match the winning numbers in the order that they were picked. Example: If the winning numbers were picked 1-2-3, only exact order plays of 1-2-3 are winners.

Pick three unique numbers to match the winning numbers in any order. There are six ways to win (six possible combinations). Example: If the winning numbers were picked 1-2-3, any plays with those numbers (such as 3-2-1) are winners.

Pick three numbers -- two of which are identical -- to match the winning numbers in any order. There are three ways to win (three possible combinations). Example: If the winning numbers were picked 1-1-2, any plays with those numbers (such as 1-2-1) are winners.

Pick two numbers to match the first two winning numbers in the order that they were picked. Example: If the winning numbers were picked 1-2-3, only exact order plays of those first two numbers (1-2-x) are winners.

Pick two numbers to match the last two winning numbers in the order that they were picked. Example: If the winning numbers were picked 1-2-3, only exact order plays of those last two numbers (x-2-3) are winners.

Pick any four numbers (unique or not) to match the winning numbers in the order that they were picked. Example: If the winning numbers were picked 1-2-3-4, only exact order plays of 1-2-3-4 are winners.

Pick four unique numbers to match the winning numbers in any order. There are 24 ways to win (24 possible combinations). Example: If the winning numbers were picked 1-2-3-4, any plays with those numbers (such as 3-2-4-1) are winners.

Pick four numbers -- two of which are identical -- to match the winning numbers in any order. There are 12 ways to win (12 possible combinations). Example: If the winning numbers were picked 1-2-1-3, any plays with those numbers (such as 3-1-1-2) are winners.

Pick four numbers -- two pairs of identical numbers -- to match the winning numbers in any order. There are six ways to win (six possible combinations). Example: If the winning numbers were picked 1-2-1-2, any plays with those numbers (such as 2-1-1-2) are winners.

Pick four numbers -- three of which are identical -- to match the winning numbers in any order. There are four ways to win (four possible combinations). Example: If the winning numbers were picked 1-1-1-2, any plays with those numbers (such as 1-2-1-1) are winners.

Pick two numbers to match the first two winning numbers in the order that they were picked. Example: If the winning numbers were picked 1-2-3-4, only exact order plays of those first two numbers (1-2-x-x) are winners.

Pick two numbers to match the last two winning numbers in the order that they were picked. Example: If the winning numbers were picked 1-2-3-4, only exact order plays of those last two numbers (x-x-3-4) are winners.
